# vastdata_cnode (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_cnode" "vastdb_cnode" {
  ip         = "10.0.1.100"
  cores      = 16
  cluster_id = 1
  force      = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The bond internal IP of the new CNode.

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (Number)
- `cluster_name` (String)
- `cores` (Number) The number of cores the CNode will use
- `dpu_ips` (String) A list of IPv4 addresses and IP ranges.
- `force` (Boolean) Force adding the CNode
- `vippool_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `bios_version` (String) BIOS version
- `bmc_fw_version` (String) BMC FW version
- `bmc_state` (String) BMC State
- `bmc_state_reason` (String) BMC state reason
- `box_vendor` (String) Parent box model description including hardware vendor
- `build` (String)
- `cbox` (String) Parent CBox
- `cbox_id` (Number) Parent CBox ID
- `cluster` (String) Parent Cluster
- `cpld` (String)
- `data_rdma_port` (Number) port for internal use
- `data_tcp_port` (Number) port for internal use
- `display_name` (String)
- `display_state` (String) State
- `enabled` (Boolean) True if the CNode is enabled
- `guid` (String) Global unique ID
- `host_label` (String) Host label, used to label container, e.g. 11.0.0.1-4000
- `host_opensm_master` (String) If OpenSM master
- `hostname` (String) Host Name
- `id` (Number) CNode ID
- `ip1` (String) 1st of two IP addresses on the cluster's internal network
- `ip2` (String) 2nd of two IP addresses on the cluster's internal network
- `ipmi_ip` (String) IP of IPMI
- `ipv6` (String) External IPv6 Address
- `is_mgmt` (Boolean) True if the CNode is currently hosting VMS
- `led_status` (String) LED status
- `mgmt_ip` (String) IP address for management access
- `name` (String)
- `new_name` (String) Name
- `opensm_state` (Boolean) opensm service state
- `os_version` (String) VAST OS version
- `platform_rdma_port` (Number) port for internal use
- `platform_tcp_port` (Number) port for internal use
- `position` (String) position of CNode in CBox
- `rpm` (String) VAST Utils Version
- `sn` (String) The host serial number
- `state` (String) State, e.g. active
- `sync` (String) Synchronization state with leader
- `sync_time` (String) Synchronization time with leader
- `title` (String)
- `tpm_boot_dev_encryption_status` (String) Boot encryption status
- `turbo_boost` (Boolean)
- `url` (String)
- `vlan` (String) VLAN ID
- `vms_preferred` (Boolean) VMS preferred CNode
